name: rpi5-sensevoice
description: Raspberry Pi 5 (CPU-only): SenseVoice offline ASR (zh/en/ja/ko/yue) via sherpa-onnx OfflineRecognizer.from_sense_voice. ASR-only transcription profile (no TTS) — SenseVoice serves the offline /asr path; streaming Paraformer also loads for /asr/stream. max_concurrent_sessions is pinned to 1: cpu.sherpa_asr declares max_concurrent=4, and one CPU decode already uses ~64% of this board's cores, so the declared ceiling is not safe here until it is measured.
